decisions.selected: Restore main-branch CI after a completed failure.
decisions.rationale: The adoption-time workflow mission is to keep the repository buildable by repairing failed CI; PR and activity counts are not operational attainment.

decisions.selected: Latest completed failing CI run on main at or before the Avenger run.
alternatives: The latest issue or pull request
decisions.rationale: The workflow's precheck explicitly selects the latest completed CI failure on main.

decisions.selected: Stable key ci-run:<database id>; reconstruct from Actions history when case and event are null.
decisions.rationale: Actions run IDs distinguish repeated failures on the same commit and preserve duplicate keys for clustering.

decisions.selected: Completed successful ci.yml run on main after the assigned failure and by the cutoff.
decisions.rationale: A successful CI run is direct repository evidence of restored buildability.

decisions.selected: Seven days after Avenger run creation, with an earlier evidenceAt cap.
decisions.rationale: The delayed recovery outcome needs a stable horizon while allowing as-of observations before maturity.

decisions.selected: Binary direct attainment: successful recovery is 1, otherwise 0; unavailable evidence is null.
decisions.rationale: The binary metric has one direct operational outcome and keeps activity and timing out of the primary value.
The workflow had no pre-adoption Avenger assignments; generic CI history is not comparable evidence for this workflow's assigned opportunities.

uncertainties.description: Actions history may be unavailable or truncated to the API page horizon.
A later successful CI run does not establish that Avenger caused the recovery.
